goal: Generate one animated Geoff preview per race from its saved ten-minute edition; no speculative or hindsight clips. Use connected ElevenLabs tools, not an API key.
steps: Keep the existing late-mail watch running. Once its initial successful pre check is saved, perform this pipeline concurrently with the bounded result watch, not after it has ended. Final-wrap slots never generate video.

Use the same Sites get_site service access as the updater, held only in memory and passed through hidden stdin. Download the current publisher, finisher and config from the exact linked site. Do not put tokens in arguments or files. On401/403 stop. Read /api/late-mail and verify previews[race] belongs to this meeting, has preparedAt within the final ten minutes, and jumpAt is still in the future.

Call the publisher with {token,payload:{action:"claim",race:N}}. Generate only if claimed:true. Persist the returned job.id and preview. If already claimed, read status and resume ONLY status/retrieval of recorded session IDs; never submit another paid take. Published/failed/unknown jobs are skipped and reported. One race claim is permanent for the meeting.

Editorial review before spending: speak only the saved preview.scenes narrations, in order. Preserve horse names, named attributed tipster views, confidence qualifications and uncertainty. At most100 words. No prices, fabricated quotes, implied recorded guests, unsupported equipment bonuses or win-probability claims. Do not add a greeting that displaces useful race information. The saved script now includes the required classic NZ greeting and light colloquialisms; preserve them. If the saved edition predates that style, prepend exactly "Kia ora, team. Geoff here." once and use the same final speech in captions. Keep the total within100 words.

Use ElevenLabs creative_create_flow once for this race. Reuse the uploaded Geoff asset from config through get_available_assets + add_flow_asset_node if available, or download the actual photoPath from the site and attach_reference_file using its real local path. Never use Jonesy or a stock presenter. Record flowId with action:"progress", state:"working".

Estimate ONE speech take using the exact config.voiceId and speechModel, generations_count:1. Abort without generation if blocking errors or estimate credits exceed the1000 cap. Generate once only; save speechNodeId and speechSessionId via progress state:"speech" immediately. Read status after its poll interval; no blind retry. Download completed audio and measure its duration. If over35 seconds, abort video instead of regenerating speech or retiming it.

After model-schema validation, add one video-generation node using config.videoModel, resolution480p, linked explicitly to the photo image port and completed narration audio port. Prompt natural accurate lip sync, restrained blinks/nods and preserved likeness/setting; no generated words, extra people or music. Estimate only. Abort if blocking errors or credits exceed16000. Run that node once with generations_count:1; persist videoNodeId and videoSessionId via progress state:"video" immediately. Never run the whole flow or upstream speech again.

While the video renders, transcribe the existing audio node with eleven_scribe_v1 for measured word timing, once; retrieve words JSON. Keep checking the late-mail watch process at intervals no longer than60 seconds and honour each generation status interval. If a run fails, save action:"failed" and its concise error; no paid retry.

Download completed video and audio via the returned actual media URLs. Run the downloaded finisher with SOURCE_MP4 AUDIO_MP3 PREVIEW_JSON WORDS_JSON OUTPUT_MP4. Review a representative presenter frame, longest caption, speech joins and closing; batch local corrections. Verify MP4 video/audio and duration10–45 seconds. Do not make additional ElevenLabs renders for layout fixes.

Publish using hidden stdin {token,payload:{action:"publish",race:N,id:JOB_ID,duration:MEASURED_SECONDS,videoPath:LOCAL_FINAL_MP4,captionsPath:LOCAL_VTT}}. The fixed publisher uploads bytes to durable site storage; never publish an expiring provider URL. Read /api/race-videos and verify video.preparedAt matches the claimed preview, then request a byte range from its video route. On a transport failure, check status/index before retrying publication; never regenerate media.

Report ready, blocked, failed or missed honestly. A saved schedule is not proof an unattended render succeeded. Keep original captioned briefings visible if any generation step is unavailable. Do not republish the site, change schedules, rotate credentials, place bets or send broadcasts from this workflow.
style: Always open with a classic NZ greeting or saying. Preserve the greeting and light colloquialisms already included in the saved script: Kia ora, Gidday, For mine, have a squiz. Use natural warmth, not a caricature or slang in every line. Do not rewrite names, source facts, tipster attributions or confidence caveats. No extra improvised speech beyond the saved script.
